note: Quote of the day: short sayings from Jewish sources. The translations convey the meaning; each quote is to be checked with a rabbi (docs/RABBI-REVIEW.md, section “Quote of the day”).

quotes.text: The world stands on three things: on Torah, on the service of the Almighty, and on acts of kindness.
quotes.author: Shimon HaTzaddik

quotes.text: Let your house be a meeting place for the sages: sit in the dust at their feet and drink in their words with thirst.
quotes.author: Yose ben Yoezer

quotes.text: Let your house be wide open, and let the poor be members of your household.
quotes.author: Yose ben Yochanan

quotes.text: Make for yourself a teacher, acquire for yourself a friend, and judge every person favorably.
quotes.author: Yehoshua ben Perachyah

quotes.text: Love work.
quotes.author: Shemaya

quotes.text: Sages, be careful with your words.
quotes.author: Avtalyon

quotes.text: Be among the disciples of Aaron: love peace and pursue peace, love people and bring them closer to the Torah.
quotes.author: Hillel

quotes.text: If I am not for myself, who will be for me? And if I am only for myself, what am I? And if not now, when?
quotes.author: Hillel

quotes.text: Make your Torah study a fixed practice, say little and do much, and greet every person cheerfully.
quotes.author: Shammai

quotes.text: Not study is the main thing, but deed.
quotes.author: Shimon, son of Rabban Gamliel

quotes.text: The world is sustained by three things: by truth, by justice and by peace.
quotes.author: Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel

quotes.text: Do not separate yourself from the community, and do not judge your fellow until you have stood in his place.
quotes.author: Hillel

quotes.text: Do not say, “When I have free time, I will study” — perhaps you will never have free time.
quotes.author: Hillel

quotes.text: The bashful person does not learn, and the short-tempered person cannot teach.
quotes.author: Hillel

quotes.text: Where there are no people, strive to be a person.
quotes.author: Hillel

quotes.text: More Torah — more life.
quotes.author: Hillel

quotes.text: Let the honor of your friend be as dear to you as your own.
quotes.author: Rabbi Eliezer

quotes.text: The day is short, and the work is great.
quotes.author: Rabbi Tarfon

quotes.text: It is not up to you to finish the work, but neither are you free to desist from it.
quotes.author: Rabbi Tarfon

quotes.text: Know where you came from, where you are going, and before Whom you are destined to give an account.
quotes.author: Akavya ben Mahalalel

quotes.text: If two sit together and words of Torah pass between them, the Shechinah rests with them.
quotes.author: Rabbi Chananya ben Teradyon

quotes.text: Whoever's good deeds exceed his wisdom, his wisdom will endure.
quotes.author: Rabbi Chanina ben Dosa

quotes.text: A fence for wisdom is silence.
quotes.author: Rabbi Akiva

quotes.text: Beloved is man, for he was created in the image of the Almighty.
quotes.author: Rabbi Akiva

quotes.text: All is foreseen, yet freedom is given.
quotes.author: Rabbi Akiva

quotes.text: Without bread there is no Torah; without Torah there is no bread.
quotes.author: Rabbi Elazar ben Azaryah

quotes.text: Who is wise? One who learns from every person.
quotes.author: Ben Zoma

quotes.text: Who is strong? One who masters his evil inclination.
quotes.author: Ben Zoma

quotes.text: Who is rich? One who rejoices in his portion.
quotes.author: Ben Zoma

quotes.text: Who is worthy of honor? One who honors people.
quotes.author: Ben Zoma

quotes.text: Hurry to fulfill even a minor mitzvah: one mitzvah brings another in its wake.
quotes.author: Ben Azzai

quotes.text: Do not despise anyone: there is no person who does not have his hour, and no thing that does not have its place.
quotes.author: Ben Azzai

quotes.text: There are three crowns: the crown of Torah, the crown of priesthood and the crown of kingship — but the crown of a good name surpasses them all.
quotes.author: Rabbi Shimon

quotes.text: This world is like a vestibule before the World to Come: prepare yourself in the vestibule so that you may enter the banquet hall.
quotes.author: Rabbi Yaakov

quotes.text: Do not look at the jug, but at what is inside it.
quotes.author: Rabbi Meir

quotes.text: One who says, “What is mine is yours, and what is yours is yours,” is pious.
Love that depends on something passes away when that thing is gone; love that does not depend on anything will never pass away.
A dispute for the sake of Heaven will endure in the end.
Be bold as a leopard, light as an eagle, swift as a deer and strong as a lion to do the will of your Father in Heaven.
quotes.author: Yehudah ben Tema

quotes.text: Turn it over and turn it over again, for everything is in it.
quotes.author: Ben Bag Bag

quotes.text: According to the effort is the reward.
quotes.author: Ben Hei Hei

quotes.text: One who learns from a friend even a single chapter or a single verse must treat him with respect.
Hear, O Israel: the L-rd is our G-d, the L-rd is One.
And these words, which I command you today, shall be upon your heart.
Justice, justice shall you pursue.
It is not in heaven… For the word is very near to you: in your mouth and in your heart, that you may do it.
I have set before you life and death, blessing and curse. Choose life.
You shall be holy, for I, the L-rd your G-d, am holy.
Love your neighbor as yourself.
Do not oppress the stranger: you know the soul of the stranger, for you yourselves were strangers in the land of Egypt.
Where you go, I will go; your people shall be my people, and your G-d my G-d.
He has told you, O man, what is good and what the L-rd requires of you: to act justly, to love kindness and to walk humbly with your G-d.
Not by might and not by power, but by My spirit, says the L-rd.
And they shall beat their swords into plowshares… Nation shall not lift up sword against nation, and they shall learn war no more.
The beginning of wisdom is awe of the L-rd.
Turn away from evil and do good, seek peace and pursue it.
Teach us to number our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.
How good and how pleasant it is when brothers dwell together.
It is a tree of life to those who hold fast to it. Its ways are ways of pleasantness, and all its paths are peace.
Train a youth at the start of his way — even when he is old he will not depart from it.
When your enemy falls, do not rejoice.
To everything there is a season, and a time for every matter under heaven.
What is hateful to you, do not do to your fellow — that is the whole Torah; the rest is commentary. Go and learn.
quotes.author: Hillel

quotes.text: Just as He is gracious and compassionate, so you too be gracious and compassionate.
quotes.author: Abba Shaul

quotes.text: Hospitality is greater than receiving the Shechinah.
Everything is in the hands of Heaven except the fear of Heaven.
Torah scholars increase peace in the world.
Whoever saves a single soul is as if he saved an entire world.
All of Israel are responsible for one another.
If someone says, “I toiled and I found,” believe him.
I have learned much from my teachers, even more from my friends, and most of all from my students.
quotes.author: Rabbi Chanina

quotes.text: Great is study, for it leads to deeds.
“Love your neighbor as yourself” — this is a great principle of the Torah.
quotes.author: Rabbi Akiva

quotes.text: See My works, how beautiful they are… Take care of My world; do not spoil it or destroy it.
Accept the truth from whoever speaks it.
Every person can become righteous like Moshe or wicked like Yarovam: the choice is his.
quotes.source: Rambam, Mishneh Torah, Laws of Teshuvah 5:2

quotes.text: Great is peace: the entire Torah was given to bring peace to the world.
quotes.source: Rambam, Mishneh Torah, Laws of Chanukah 4:14

quotes.text: If you believe that it is possible to damage, believe that it is also possible to repair.
quotes.author: Rabbi Nachman of Breslov

quotes.text: The whole world is a very narrow bridge, and the main thing is not to be afraid at all.
quotes.author: Rabbi Nachman of Breslov

quotes.text: The old will be renewed, and the new will be sanctified.
quotes.author: Rav Avraham Yitzchak Kook
